CREATE TABLE #Entity_ILOS
(
    EntityId BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,

    LongName NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    ShortName NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    EntityType NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    BusinessPortfolio NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcCifNumber NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CreditPortfolio NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    Prospect NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    TaxId NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CountryOfInc NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcRegistrationDate DATE NULL,
    RegistrationNumber NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcCooperativeId NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    ConnectedParty NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcRelatedParty NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    Descriptions NVARCHAR(500) NULL,
    CbcGroupName NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    CbcGroupId NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcSingleBorrowerLimit BIGINT NULL,
    CbcBorrowerSince DATE NULL,
    CbcDepositorSince DATE NULL,
    LastReviewDate DATE NULL,
    NextReviewDate DATE NULL,
    Division NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    RestrictedEntity NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    PrimaryBankingOfficer NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    PrimaryCreditOfficer NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    CbcContactName NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    FirmType NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CountryOfRisk NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    Currency NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
    CbcFirmSize NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcGenderOfCompany NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    ListingDate DATE NULL,
    CountryOfListing NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    StockExchange NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    StockCode NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    IndClassification NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcNatureOfBusiness NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    Salutation NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
    CbcFirstName NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    CbcMiddleName NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    CbcSuffix NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
    CustomerSince DATE NULL,
    DateOfBirth DATE NULL,
    Nationality1 NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CountryOfRes NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    Gender NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
    CbcNoOfDependents INT NULL,
    CbcHomeOwnership NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcOccupation NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    CurrentEmp NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    CbcEmploymentDate DATE NULL,
    Designation NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    BusinessType NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcRelatedPartyClassIndividual NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcIsNonSystemUser BIT NULL
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
);

WITH CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT AS (
    SELECT
        MI.ORGKEY,
        MI.STRTEXT2,
        MI.DTDATE1,
        MI.STRTEXT9,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY MI.ORGKEY
            ORDER BY MI.DTDATE1 DESC
        ) AS RN
    FROM EDS.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO MI
    WHERE MI.TYPE = 'CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT'
)

INSERT INTO #Entity_ILOS
(
    LongName,
    ShortName,
    EntityType,
    BusinessPortfolio,
    CbcCifNumber,
    CreditPortfolio,
    Prospect,
    TaxId,
    CountryOfInc,
    CbcRegistrationDate,
    RegistrationNumber,
    CbcCooperativeId,
    ConnectedParty,
    CbcRelatedParty,
    Descriptions,
    CbcGroupName,
    CbcGroupId,
    CbcSingleBorrowerLimit,
    CbcBorrowerSince,
    CbcDepositorSince,
    LastReviewDate,
    NextReviewDate,
    Division,
    RestrictedEntity,
    PrimaryBankingOfficer,
    PrimaryCreditOfficer,
    CbcContactName,
    FirmType,
    CountryOfRisk,
    Currency,
    CbcFirmSize,
    CbcGenderOfCompany,
    ListingDate,
    CountryOfListing,
    StockExchange,
    StockCode,
    IndClassification,
    CbcNatureOfBusiness,
    Salutation,
    CbcFirstName,
    CbcMiddleName,
    CbcSuffix,
    CustomerSince,
    DateOfBirth,
    Nationality1,
    CountryOfRes,
    Gender,
    CbcNoOfDependents,
    CbcHomeOwnership,
    CbcOccupation,
    CurrentEmp,
    CbcEmploymentDate,
    Designation,
    BusinessType,
    CbcRelatedPartyClassIndividual,
    CbcIsNonSystemUser
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.CORPORATE_NAME
        ELSE CUST.CUST_LAST_NAME
    END AS LongName,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.SHORT_NAME
        ELSE CUST.SHORT_NAME
    END AS ShortName,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.LEGALENTITY_TYPE
        ELSE 'CUSTOMER'
    END AS EntityType,

    NULL AS BusinessPortfolio,

    CUST.ORGKEY AS CbcCifNumber,

    NULL AS CreditPortfolio,
    NULL AS Prospect,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.TAXID
        ELSE CUST.GENERALTAXID
    END AS TaxId,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.COUNTRYOFINCORPORATION
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CountryOfInc,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.DATE_OF_INCORPORATION
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcRegistrationDate,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.REGISTRATION_NUMBER
        ELSE NULL
    END AS RegistrationNumber,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.STRUSERFIELD10
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcCooperativeId,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.STRUSERFIELD22
        ELSE CUST.STRUSERFIELD22
    END AS ConnectedParty,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.STRUSERFIELD23
        ELSE CUST.STRUSERFIELD23
    END AS CbcRelatedParty,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.STRUSERFIELD24
        ELSE CUST.STRUSERFIELD24
    END AS Descriptions,

    GHH.GROUPHOUSEHOLDNAME AS CbcGroupName,
    GHH.GROUPHOUSEHOLDID AS CbcGroupId,

    42680364174 AS CbcSingleBorrowerLimit,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.DATE4
        ELSE CUST.DTDATE4
    END AS CbcBorrowerSince,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.DATE3
        ELSE CUST.DTDATE5
    END AS CbcDepositorSince,

    NULL AS LastReviewDate,
    NULL AS NextReviewDate,
    NULL AS Division,
    NULL AS RestrictedEntity,
    NULL AS PrimaryBankingOfficer,
    NULL AS PrimaryCreditOfficer,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.KEYCONTACT_PERSONNAME
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcContactName,

    NULL AS FirmType,
    NULL AS CountryOfRisk,
    NULL AS Currency,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN FIN.STR7
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcFirmSize,

    NULL AS CbcGenderOfCompany,
    NULL AS ListingDate,
    NULL AS CountryOfListing,
    NULL AS StockExchange,
    NULL AS StockCode,
    NULL AS IndClassification,
    NULL AS CbcNatureOfBusiness,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN CUST.SALUTATION
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Salutation,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN CUST.CUST_FIRST_NAME
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcFirstName,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN CUST.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcMiddleName,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN CUST.NAMESUFFIX
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcSuffix,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN CUST.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CustomerSince,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN CUST.CUST_DOB
        ELSE NULL
    END AS DateOfBirth,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN DEMO.NATIONALITY
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Nationality1,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN DEMO.RESIDENCE_COUNTRY
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CountryOfRes,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN CUST.GENDER
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Gender,

    NULL AS CbcNoOfDependents,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN DEMO.RESIDENTIAL_STATUS
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcHomeOwnership,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN EMP.STRTEXT2
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcOccupation,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN DEMO.EMPLOYERSNAME
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CurrentEmp,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN EMP.DTDATE1
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcEmploymentDate,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN EMP.STRTEXT9
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Designation,

    NULL AS BusinessType,
    NULL AS CbcRelatedPartyClassIndividual,

    CAST(1 AS BIT) AS CbcIsNonSystemUser

FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_CORPORATE CORP
    ON CORP.CORP_KEY = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD GHH
    ON GHH.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_FINANCIAL FIN
    ON FIN.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC DEMO
    ON DEMO.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT EMP
    ON EMP.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY
    AND EMP.RN = 1

WHERE CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE IN ('Corporate', 'Retail')
    AND CUST.STRUSERFIELD8 IS NOT NULL
    AND CUST.ISLATEST = 1;

SELECT * FROM #Entity_ILOS ORDER BY EntityId
